title: Scalar-unit comparison for the section-source constants
statement:
Scalar-unit comparison for the section-source constants. With the exact objects and canonical maps of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps], for every finite commutative A and arbitrary schemes and base change, the following equation holds. No Noetherian, finite-type or nonempty hypothesis is required.

theorem constant_square (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {B' B : Scheme.{u}} (g : B' ⟶ B) :
    (ProEtale.fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A g).hom.app (etaleConstant A B) ≫
        (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          (compareConstant A B).hom ≫ (proConstantPull A g).hom =
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (constantPull A g).hom ≫ (compareConstant A B').hom

proof.text: The underived comparison of constants commutes with inverse image because its unit is the terminal constant coefficient comparison. This is compare_constant_square of the supported-constant normalization.

Apply the degree-zero single functor to the underived square. The naturality of the exact-derived single comparison and its compatibility with functor composition identify the four edges with compareConstant, constantPull, proConstantPull and fixedComparisonPullbackPlus. Functoriality and cancellation prove the displayed equation.
